title: Shore Thing | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Shore Thing is a 4.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Welcome to Shore Thing, your new favorite family getaway where summer never ends. This inviting home comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests with its 4 spacious bedrooms. It is just a 5-minute stroll from the pristine shoreline. Make every moment a beachside memory at Shore Thing!Guests feel the vacation ambiance immediately as they enter the porch area with its rocking chairs and comfy seating areas. Through the front door, the main living area extends the warm welcome, awash with earthy tones and textures, from the hardwood floors to the linen couch and leather club chairs. Under a beautiful modern chandelier, you can seat 8 for more formal meals and the kitchen island has seating for 3 more. The fully-equipped kitchen features everything the home chef needs to prepare fantastic meals. The living area has ample seating around a large Smart TV for relaxing family evenings. The main floor also features a king bedroom, convenient hallway full bathroom and the laundry room.On the 2nd floor, guests have another gorgeous king bedroom suite with access to the balcony, complete with a porch swing. The 2nd floor features a queen bedroom and a bunk room. These bedrooms have easy access to the hallway bathroom.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed, Smart TV. Shared hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo.2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: King bed, Smart TV, balcony access. Private bathroom with dual sinks, shower, soaking tub.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunks, Smart TV.2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: Queen bed, Smart TV.Bedrooms 3 and 4 share hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo.Guests can walk or take the shuttle to the beach, making use of beach chairs provided with the house, as well as the sparkling 12,000-square-foot pool which has several areas to enjoy. Shore Thing is the perfect home in Seacrest Beach for families and friends ready to relax and take advantage of everything 30A has to offer.Beach Access:Distance: .2 miles | Time: 5 minutes walkingSeacrest Beach II:The showstopper of the area is the 12,000 square-foot lagoon pool. With a waterfall, fountain, and children's splash area we know you'll find your perfect pool day at Seacrest. Surrounded by palm trees and poolside loungers, it might be hard to split your time between this pool and the beautiful Gulf.Your stay at Shore Thing comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 2 cars.* Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 30 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
